actors.authority: Supabase Auth account created; email confirmation pending

actors.session: server-side opaque app session + separate admin session

channels/@me.profile_source: server-side browser session; username originates from validated registration metadata/provider profile
channels/@me.first_server_modal: captured DOM preserved; only close action is wired
channels/@me.localization: static PT-BR text/ARIA in channels.html; no runtime translation script; captured structure/classes/styles/order remain intact
channels/@me.verification_required_flow: captured fullscreen root; Verify by Email opens modal; Resend Email and Change Email are wired in PT-BR
channels/@me.change_email: POST /api/auth/change-email; current password proof server-side; duplicate email/password mismatch use captured field errors

friend_requests.pending_view: single peopleColumn swapped with add_friend-tab; never side-by-side
friend_requests.incoming_badges: Pending tab + Friends sidebar; count received pending only

trust_boundaries: local administrator -> privileged local control routes
authenticated browser -> hCaptcha -> Flask friend request -> public.friend_requests
browser cookie jar -> Flask paired session contract
Flask SessionAuthority -> Supabase auth.users liveness check

authorization.admin_source: validated local admin credential + server-side admin session
authorization.post_login_shell: deny anonymous; allow pending/user through centralized Policy shell.read
authorization.pending_user: restricted to shell/session/email-verification capabilities; no admin permissions

server_actor_model.authorization: closed Policy catalog; unknown permission denied

client_architecture.translation: static channels.html and direct PT-BR strings in transient UI markup; no DOM translation pass
client_architecture.session_actor: assets/js/ui/session-watchdog.js singleton; one owner for cookie presence + server liveness
client_architecture.initial_session_state: server bootstrap, then periodic authority heartbeat; no duplicate verification-status request during boot

transitions.register.success: /channels/@me with role user when confirmed, pending when confirmation is required
transitions.pending.email.confirmed: POST verification/status upgrades server-side role pending -> user and removes banner
transitions.friend.request.pending.rate_limit: Verification Required -> Verify by Email modal
transitions.pending.email.change: password proof -> Auth Admin email update -> local role remains pending -> resend verification
transitions.session.cookie.removed: client presence sentinel redirects immediately; next server request denies without paired cookie
transitions.session.user.deleted: admin deletion revokes all local sessions immediately; external deletion detected by short authority heartbeat/lease

session_runtime.authority: server-owned SessionAuthority; browser state is never authorization authority

presence_cookie.name: app_presence
presence_cookie.meaning: non-secret HMAC-bound companion to app_sid; required on every server session lookup
presence_cookie.purpose: detect browser cookie deletion without exposing the opaque session token

session_runtime.rotation: new opaque token at authentication; previous token deleted
session_runtime.cookie_delete_detection: Cookie Store API when available; otherwise checked on focus/pageshow/visibility/online and protected actions
session_runtime.authority_validation: event-driven GET /api/session/validate on browser activity/security events; no periodic heartbeat
session_runtime.server_reads: SQLite session reads are side-effect free; no periodic session traffic
session_runtime.database_transport: bounded LIFO pool of four PostgreSQL connections
session_runtime.page_bootstrap: server-rendered inert app-session-bootstrap JSON; no initial /api/session round trip on the critical path
session_runtime.spa_navigation: History API + same-origin partial fetch; persistent guild rail and account panel are not replaced
session_runtime.failure: missing/tampered companion, missing opaque cookie, stale auth version, expired local session, or missing auth.users principal => deny/revoke
